Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.
We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. About the Role
Twitch is building the future of interactive entertainment. The Data Platform team develops and operates the data platform that powers data systems and decision-making. Our data pipeline receives over 200 billion events a day, and we forward live data to tens of systems as well as powering decisions at all levels of Twitch. We provide tools to store, transform, move, and understand data.
As a software engineer on Data Platform, you will deliver the next generation of Twitch data technology. You will build tools which are reliable and scale. You’ll review and shape the work of your peers, and participate in a collaborative engineering team.
You can work from San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA.
You Will:
Develop new capabilities in our data warehouses and pipelines
Improve the reliability, flexibility, and scalability of our existing tools
Collaborate on our vision as we scale to our next petabyte
Enhance our workflows using AI tooling
You Have:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent industry experience as a Software Engineer
Familiarity with scalability, concurrency, API design, data modeling, and distributed systems fundamentals
Familiarity with AI coding tools
Bonus Points
Experience using Golang or Python
Experience with distributed, highly available systems
Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Contributions to open source

9th Way Insignia is a service-disabled, veteran-owned small business bringing transformative technology to our government customers so they can achieve their missions.  Our specialties include cybersecurity, cloud modernization, software development, data analytics, enterprise architecture, enterprise IT, analytics, process automation, and artificial intelligence.  Learn more about 9th Way Insignia at https://9thwayinsignia.com/.

Project Introduction
The Department of Veterans Affairs Cybersecurity Operations and Services Enterprise (COSE) program delivers the enterprise cybersecurity operations, engineering, architecture, risk, and compliance support that safeguards VA systems, data, and mission delivery. The team helps strengthen the cyber resilience of the digital services relied on by Veterans, their families, and the VA workforce.
9th Way Insignia is seeking a Cybersecurity Data Analyst (CDM) to support this program. This position is contingent upon contract award.
Professional Level
E2 – Engineer
Responsibilities
Analyze cybersecurity and continuous-diagnostics data to identify vulnerabilities, control gaps, asset issues, and risk trends.
Validate data quality, normalize findings, reconcile asset and vulnerability records, and support reporting accuracy.
Develop dashboards, recurring reports, and data-driven recommendations for remediation and risk prioritization.
Coordinate with system owners, security teams, and operations teams to resolve data discrepancies and verify remediation status.
Document analytical methods, data definitions, assumptions, and results.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, data analytics, information systems, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Four or more years of cybersecurity analysis, vulnerability management, continuous diagnostics and mitigation, data analysis, or related experience.
Experience working with asset, vulnerability, configuration, compliance, or security-event data.
Ability to analyze data sets, identify trends and discrepancies, and communicate actionable findings.
Experience with reporting, dashboarding, spreadsheets, SQL, or comparable data-analysis tools.
